queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyHint: Add tracks to keep the music playing
queue.trackCount: {count, plural, one {# track in queue} other {# tracks in queue}}

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. The app will switch immediately.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pick a theme. "Minimal" keeps the pure monochrome look; the others apply soft corners, warmer surfaces, and an accent color used for likes, the play button, and the progress bar.

audio.title: Audio Quality
audio.description: Choose the audio quality for streaming and downloads.
audio.scopeNote: Applies to Internet Archive only — FunkWhale and your folders use whatever the file provides.

lowest.label: Lowest Quality
lowest.description: Smallest file sizes. Best for mobile data or slow connections. Formats: 64kbps MP3, 128kbps MP3, Ogg Vorbis.

medium.label: Medium Quality (Recommended)
medium.description: Good balance of quality and size. Formats: VBR MP3, 128kbps MP3, Ogg Vorbis.

best.label: Best Quality
best.description: Highest quality available. Larger file sizes. Formats: FLAC (lossless), 320kbps MP3, VBR MP3.

note.body: Quality applies to both streaming and offline downloads. Not all items have all formats available - the app will use the best match.
